About.title: The Sacred Mission of Evangelizae
About.subtitle: "Technology in Service of Faith and Christian Life" — Veritas • Communio • Missio
About.introText: The modern digital world has been shaped by algorithms of distraction, anxiety, and instant vanity. Even Catholic apps and tools often fall into the trap of 'secular gamification': leaderboards, ego badges, and public rankings that turn prayer and interior life into a productivity competition.
About.introText2: Evangelizae was born as a purified refuge and a faithful missionary response aligned with the Sacred Magisterium of the Catholic Church. Our mission is not to trap your attention on a screen. For us, technology is merely a transitory tool, never an end in itself.
About.goalBoxTitle: The Ultimate Goal: From Screen to Altar
About.goalBoxQuote: "The true success of this platform happens at the exact moment you turn off the screen, kneel before the Blessed Sacrament in the Tabernacle, and live out practical charity in your physical Parish."
About.goalBoxSub: We do not want to keep you glued to your phone. We want to prepare your heart for Confession, Eucharistic Adoration, and Sacramental Life in your local community.
About.pillarsSub: Spiritual foundations that govern every line of code and decision in this project
About.c1Desc: In strict adherence to the Deposit of Faith (Depositum Fidei). All reflections and our Theological AI Assistant are grounded strictly in Sacred Scripture, the Catechism (CCC), and Vatican Documents, without private speculation.
About.c2Desc: We intentionally abolished leaderboards, public rankings, and display badges. Your spiritual streak and Rosary consistency are a sacred secret between your soul, God, and His Holy Church.
About.c3Desc: On the Intercessory Wall, we do not allow debate comments or public judgment. When a brother or sister shares a sorrow or intention, the community's only response is silent charity: '🙏 I prayed for you'.
About.c4Desc: We will never charge fees, never sell 'Pro/Premium' subscriptions, never display commercial advertisements, and never put paywalls on the Word of God. Our support comes purely through divine providence and voluntary donations.
About.ctaText: This platform is consecrated to the Immaculate Heart of Mary under the patronage of St. Joseph. Join us on this journey to sanctify daily routine.

Landing.heroTitle: A Peaceful Space to Encounter God in Your Daily Life
Landing.heroSubtitle: Welcome. Evangelizae is a simple and serene refuge, created out of love for the Church to help you cultivate daily prayer, meditate on the Word, and walk in peace.
Landing.todayTitle: What does your soul need today?
Landing.todaySubtitle: Welcome today's Grace through the Daily Liturgy and Holy Rosary
Landing.pathsTitle: Paths of Prayer and Interior Life
Landing.pathsSubtitle: Gentle daily steps to nourish your faith and draw your heart closer to Christ
Landing.pillarPrayerDesc: A meditative step-by-step Rosary with gentle haptic rhythm, scriptural passages per decade, and quiet spiritual recollection.
Landing.pillarFormationDesc: Mass readings of the day, Church-faithful reflections, and a reference guide grounded strictly in Scripture and the Catechism.
Landing.pillarCommunionDesc: A fraternal space to place your intentions and silently pray for others through '🙏 I prayed for you', without public noise or debate.
Landing.pillarChurchDesc: Evangelizae never replaces physical community. Our deepest desire is to nourish your spirit so you can live the Sacraments and Adoration in your local parish.
Landing.philTitle: A Refuge Without Ads, Products, or Vanity
Landing.philSubtitle: Built from scratch as a friendly companion, free of addictive algorithms and commercialization of faith
Landing.philNoAddictionDesc: No intrusive notifications or retention traps. The goal is simply to pray and carry on with your day in peace.
Landing.philNoRankingDesc: Your spiritual journey is an intimate mystery of love between you and God. No public leaderboards or comparison points.
Landing.philMagisteriumDesc: All prayers, reflections, and guidance are strictly faithful to Sacred Tradition, Scripture, and the Catechism.
Landing.philFreeForeverDesc: We will never charge anything, there are no 'Pro' tiers or ads. Support comes solely through voluntary gifts from those who wish to help sustain server costs.
Landing.donationBannerDesc: This project is completely free for everyone. If Evangelizae has been a blessing to your journey and you wish to voluntarily support technical hosting costs, your kindness will be welcomed with heartfelt gratitude and prayer.
